scenario.description: A discussion unfolds between two individuals after a surprising revelation about a personal relationship.

agent_a.name: Sophia

profile.personality_and_values: Sophia James is exuberant, spontaneous, and pleasure-seeking, often making impulsive decisions.
profile.public_info: Sophia enjoys spending time outdoors, hiking, and rock climbing.

agent_a.goal: Confess to your friend that you have been involved with their long-term partner (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been involved with your friend's partner knowingly and want to come clean.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Sophia wants to confess because her spontaneous nature compels her to be honest about her involvement.

agent_b.name: Miles

profile.personality_and_values: Miles Hawkins, spontaneous and free-spirited, values sanctity and benevolence. He is impulsive and relies on his instincts when making decisions.
profile.public_info: Miles Hawkins, a chef, is a green thumb enthusiast and spends his free time tending to his kitchen garden, using some of his fresh produce in his dishes.

agent_b.goal: Maintain the friendship without causing a huge argument (<extra_info>Extra information: you don't want to lose a good friend over this.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Miles wants to maintain the friendship so that he can preserve the sanctity of their bond.
